scope_allowed: Relevance of the validation activities to the COU

models.name: TRSB-FE: Thread-Resolved Screw–Bone Model
models.what_it_computes: Implicit nonlinear contact and damage simulation capturing thread flank engagement, insertion and stripping torque, axial pullout force–displacement behavior, and local bone stress/strain distribution.

models.name: HTA-FE: Homogenized Trabecular Anchor Model
models.what_it_computes: Implicit continuum model with anisotropic elastic–plastic trabecular surrogate and interface elements to predict anchor stiffness, early micromotion under bending, and degradation under cyclic off-axis toggling.

mechanisms.name: Monotonic axial pullout resistance
mechanisms.why_it_matters: Dominant extraction failure that governs fixation retention following implantation and during acute postoperative loading.

mechanisms.name: Thread stripping at peak insertion torque
mechanisms.why_it_matters: Loss of thread purchase during insertion compromises fixation and correlates with early loosening risk.

mechanisms.name: Off-axis toggling–induced loosening
mechanisms.why_it_matters: Repetitive cranio-caudal and medial–lateral moments at the screw–bone interface degrade purchase under physiologic motion.

mechanisms.name: Early micromotion under physiologic bending
mechanisms.why_it_matters: Small displacements at the anchor reflect purchase quality and influence construct stability during healing.

deviation.detail: All factor scores are reported on a 0–9 Credibility Index (0=minimal evidence, 9=compelling evidence) for each model × mechanism pair.

expected_decision.outcome_source: The two models provide complementary utility for the intended clinical question of bone purchase, with TRSB-FE preferred where thread geometry and local crushing govern response and HTA-FE preferred where continuum anisotropy and interface degradation dominate.

models: homogenized trabecular anchor model with interface elements (HTA-FE)
acceptance_criteria: density-mapped properties with no specimen-specific curve fitting beyond two global coefficients fixed from independent data
monotonic pullout predictions within 15% mean absolute percentage error and R2 ≥ 0.80 on cadaveric data
end-to-end data linkage for at least 90% of anchors
test conditions matched to modeled boundary conditions within 5% on rate and amplitude
test coverage exceeding 70% for custom code elements
